overview_description.description:
Buguard is a globally positioned cybersecurity startup headquartered in Singapore with an operational office in Egypt and a MENA regional office in Saudi Arabia.
Buguard represent Dark Atlas, an AI-powered eXtended Dark Web Intelligence platform, DarkAtlas, focuses on Dark Web Monitoring, Digital Risk Protection, Cyber Threat Intelligence, and Attack Surface Management. With DarkAtlas, you gain proactive defense through actionable and contextualized intelligence, ensuring robust protection against evolving cyber threats.
